kind: v34 pool/split structure of the measured success arm (verdict bffe5adf flaw 1)

pooled_all.role: all six rungs, including the disclosed sub-floor short-walk rung

heterogeneity.test: Cochran Q over the CLAIM population (long-walk rungs, ell>=64)

all_six_rungs.driver: the ell=16 short-walk rung (q=0.3718), which is the disclosed sub-floor control and is NOT in the claim's pool

heterogeneity.note: Q below the 5% point means the rung-to-rung spread is what binomial sampling gives at 20k trials/rung, i.e. no measured split-dependence beyond noise

cluster_bootstrap_over_rungs.statistic: Wilson lower of the resampled pool
cluster_bootstrap_over_rungs.role: cluster-robust lower bound on the common q

consumption_unit.production: ONE pool: nb=2^45 bases multiplied against ONE shared walk list of ell=2^70.650 positions; the production record set is the Cartesian product, so the arm's per-trial unit IS the production consumption unit
consumption_unit.floor_level: the 0.39 floor is asserted at the POOL level (the single production pool), and separately reported per rung; it is NOT asserted at the rung level for every rung
consumption_unit.disclosure: 3 of 7 rungs have a per-rung CP-95 lower endpoint below 0.39; those rungs are at -1.53, -0.84, 5.33 SE from the floor, i.e. the misses are sampling noise at 20k trials, and the claim does not rest on them: it rests on the 200k-trial pooled endpoint, whose rung-level heterogeneity is tested above and is not significant
